connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image nordic-registry-mcp-server:1.0.2. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the olgasafonova account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
